messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT: P0 - KV cache memory spike and allocator failures (auto-paging to oncall)
oncall-kv: saw pager, connecting. brief: nodes in pool gpu-pool-3 showing repeated cuda OOM during continuous batching. memory for kv arena jumping from 12GB -> 70GB in minutes.
maria: confirming. metrics: kv_cache_used_tokens increased 10x, continuous_batch_size jumped to 512 for a short window. p50 gen latency spiked from 40ms to 450ms and token costs exploded.
ajay: logs show repeated `pytorch::cuda::alloc::fail` in arena allocator, stack references to kv_arena::reslice.
dan: also seeing elevated failed RPCs to model-worker and slow tails on redis eviction. some nodes restarted by k8s due to OOMKills.
leah: customer-impact: two enterprise customers (acct: acme-inc, beta-ml) reported 502s and degraded throughput. CS reported one in-product alert at 09:11 UTC.
oncall-kv: triage plan: 1) isolate affected GPU pool from LB 2) scale up dedicated reserve to absorb inflight 3) apply temp batch throttle config 4) run compact on arenas + restart workers with tuned arena params.
ops_bot: action: removed pool gpu-pool-3 from routing at 09:15:23 UTC.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: escalation sent to infra-leads; on-call handoff in progress.
maria: hotfix config we can push to runtime: {
  "continuous_batch": { "max_tokens": "64", "max_requests": "8", "adaptive": "false" }
}
ajay: applying hotfix to routing config as a quick mitigation. will patch canary first (2 nodes) then roll.
leah: can we confirm persistence state of KV shards? risk of fragmentation if we evict aggressively.
dan: confirmed shards remain; fragmentation rising. running `kv_arena:compact(true)` might help but requires worker restart to free CUDA arenas.
oncall-kv: doing canary patch now on worker-17/18. issuing `kubectl annotate deploy/kv-worker run=slab-shock-mitigate` and restart.
maria: patched canary at 09:21:04 UTC. telemetry: continuous_batch_size dropped to under 80 and token rate normalized on canary.
ajay: if canary is stable for 3m, roll to rest of nodes. initiating rolling restart with `--set arena.max_slices=256 --set arena.fragment_threshold=0.6`
ops_bot: rolling restart started at 09:25:40 UTC. estimated complete 09:34 UTC.
leah: customer-impact update: acme-inc still seeing errors intermittently; pause ingest for them and route to fallback stage for now.
oncall-kv: note: we suspect a recent change to adaptive batching made the runtime aggressively increase batch sizes during low-traffic anomalies. combined with KV slab interleaving this caused huge fragmentation and malloc failures.
dan: I have a dump of the allocator state. snippets:
```
Arena summary: total_allocated=73.4GB, active_slices=1024, free_slices=8, fragmentation_ratio=0.87
Backtraces: kv_alloc->cont_batch->cuda_malloc
```

maria: after 2nd roll iteration memory per node has dropped to 14GB. p50 latency back to 48ms. error rate down to baseline.
ajay: marking incident mitigated at 09:33:58 UTC. still keeping pool out of rotation for 15m for observation.
customer-success: noted customer alert was acknowledged and CS contacted both acme-inc and beta-ml with status. no data loss reported.
oncall-kv: postmortem actions (initial): 1) revert/guard the adaptive batch ramp change to avoid >128 token bursts; 2) add allocator telemetry export for per-shard fragmentation and slice counts; 3) add automatic compact-and-restart job when fragmentation_ratio > 0.7; 4) create a routing failover to spare pools on OOM spike.
leah: estimate impact: ~35k requests affected, 2 customers with degraded SLA during 09:10-09:34 UTC. financial exposure flagged for biz to review.
pd-bot: incident update: mitigation in place. paging cleared to oncall once monitoring stabilized.
oncall-kv: handing off to night SREs. please pick up follow-ups: infra-leads to review allocator changes, runtime to implement throttle guard, product to notify customers if needed.
maria: attaching snippet of the temp throttle script we used:
```
# temp throttle
curl -X POST https://runtime.internal/api/v1/config \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \ 
  -d '{"continuous_batch":{"max_tokens":64,"max_requests":8}}'
```

ajay: closing thread for primary triage. will file full postmortem doc with timeline, graphs, and remediation RFC.
ops_bot: pool gpu-pool-3 placed back into rotation at 09:50:12 UTC after 15m hold and green checks.
sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: services stable. create retrospective ticket: infra-1789 (kv-slab-shock).
